subject: Educação Física
description_pt: Praticar um ou mais esportes de rede/parede, campo e taco, invasão e combate oferecidos pela escola, usando habilidades técnico-táticas básicas.

components.description_pt: Executar habilidades técnicas básicas em pelo menos um esporte de cada categoria oferecida
components.description_en: Execute basic technical skills in at least one sport from each category offered by the school

components.description_pt: Aplicar habilidades táticas fundamentais durante jogos em esportes de rede/parede, invasão, campo/bastão ou combate
components.description_en: Apply fundamental tactical skills during gameplay in net/wall, invasion, fielding/striking, or combat sports

components.description_pt: Participar ativamente de esportes oferecidos pela escola, demonstrando adesão às regras e fair play
components.description_en: Participate actively in school-offered sports, demonstrating adherence to rules and fair play
components.cc_component_description: Follow agreed-upon rules and norms for participating effectively in one-on-one, group, and teacher-led discussions

cc_matches.description: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on grade 8 topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing their own clearly.
